title: Exercise and Diet Effects in Reducing Cardiovascular Risk in Kidney Transplant Recipients
official: Effects of Exercise and Dietary Counselling in Reducing the Cardiovascular Risk Score in Kidney Transplant Patients: KT- LIFESTYLE Study
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to assess whether, over an observation period of 3 years, there is a reduction in cardiovascular risk, and the extent of this reduction, in a group of adult kidney transplant patients undergoing tailored exercise combined with dietary counselling compared to a group of patients following the 'standard of care'.
